title: psilocarphus berteroi
intro: Psilocarphus berteroi, commonly known as the Giant Woollyheads, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is a perennial herb that is native to the western coast of North America, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Psilocarphus berteroi include its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation, making it a potential remedy for gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
